proposals.title: ADRs for hash + rounding enforcement + implement packages/core primitives
proposals.why_now: packages/core is the root dependency for every other package. Without nominal branded types (Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick), the positional RNG, and integer division helpers with explicit rounding modes, no other FASE-1 package can contain any production code. ADR-002 requires a bit-exact hash specification before the RNG is implemented; ADR-004 requires the rounding enforcement mechanism to be specified before any division helper exists. These two ADRs are the minimum to unblock core and everything downstream.

proposals.title: ADR-009 + implement packages/core CanonicalEncoder and StateHash/SaveHash
proposals.why_now: The spec mandates that ADR-009 be written and the CanonicalEncoder implemented before any StateHash computation exists anywhere in the codebase. INV-22 requires that logically equal states produce identical canonical bytes and logically different states produce different bytes. Without the encoder, no invariant test can verify state equality, and the replay CLI (tools/replay) cannot compare hashes. This must be completed before world, domain, or application produce any state.

proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance requires market orders (buy and sell spot), and those require the multi-commodity double-entry ledger. INV-04, INV-05, INV-06, and INV-07 all depend on domain being implemented with correct ledger semantics. This is the second domain-adjacent package that unlocks application and replay.

proposals.title: Implement tick loop, save/replay, tools/replay CLI, tools/bench, and minimal Electron installer
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance requires: (1) the canonical tick processing order implemented in a single place in application, (2) the ADR-006 save format with seed + action log + finalTick, (3) tools/replay comparing two runs and reporting the first divergent tick, (4) tools/bench with calibration baseline frozen in a versioned file, (5) simulation running in the dedicated worker, (6) a minimal installer for Windows and Linux from CI. The spec explicitly states that the installer must exist in FASE-1 in minimal form because discovering packaging problems late is unrecoverable. INV-01 and INV-11 also become testable only once replay exists.

repository_assessment.current_state: Monorepo scaffold accepted (TASK-0002): 16 npm workspaces, strict TypeScript, blocking lint and dependency-boundary gates, CI, SPEC_BLOCKERS registry. Every implementation file is `export {}`. No production algorithm, type, or test exists in any package.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: packages/core is empty; no nominal types, no positional RNG, no integer arithmetic helpers with explicit rounding modes, and no CanonicalEncoder exist. Every other FASE-1 package depends on core, and three DEFINIR items (hash function, rounding enforcement, CanonicalEncoder spec) require ADRs before implementation can start.
